expectedItems.name: Paracetamol
expectedItems.sourceSentence: Take Paracetamol 500 mg as directed for pain.

expectedItems.name: Full weight bearing
expectedItems.sourceSentence: Use crutches and do not put full weight on the injured ankle until reviewed.

expectedItems.name: Ankle and toe exercises
expectedItems.sourceSentence: Perform the ankle and toe exercises twice daily as demonstrated by physiotherapy.

expectedItems.name: Severe swelling
expectedItems.sourceSentence: Seek help for severe swelling, numbness, blue discoloration, or uncontrolled pain.
